function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | Description | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|-------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Combines the length of boxers with the snugness of briefs. | Everyday wear, gym, travel. | • Full‑leg coverage
• Good support
• Breathable fabrics (cotton, modal, bamboo)
• Seamless or flat‑lock seams | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑leg, snug fit that sits just above the hips. | Work, casual, sports. | • Tight fit for support
• Minimal bulk
• Often made from cotton or microfiber | | **Trunks** | Shorter than boxer briefs, similar to briefs but with a bit more leg coverage. | Fashion, active wear. | • Sleek silhouette
• Good for low‑cut pants
• Usually cotton or performance blends | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑leg, relaxed fit. | Sleep, lounging, casual. | • Maximum airflow
• Soft cotton or modal
• Often printed or patterned | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive underwear designed to reduce friction. | Athletic performance, post‑workout recovery. | • Elastic waistband
• Moisture‑wicking fabric
• Often includes a small pouch for added support | | **Boys’ Style (Boyshorts)** | Short, snug, and often with a higher waistband. | Trendy fashion, some athletic wear. | • Comfortable for tight pants
• Usually cotton or blends | | **Thermal/Insulated** | Heavier, often with a fleece lining. | Cold climates, winter sports. | • Warmth retention
• Moisture‑wicking base layer | | **Eco‑Friendly** | Made from sustainable materials (organic cotton, bamboo, recycled polyester). | Eco‑conscious consumers. | • Low environmental impact
• Often certified (GOTS, OEKO‑Tex) | --- ## How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity** (sleep, lounging): Boxers or loose briefs. - **Moderate activity** (daily commute, light exercise): Boxer briefs or trunks. - **High activity** (running, weightlifting): Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. 2. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the natural waist without digging in. Look for a smooth, elastic band. - **Legs**: Avoid overly tight legs that restrict circulation; avoid overly loose legs that bunch up. - **Support**: If you need extra support (e.g., for sports), choose briefs or compression styles with a pouch or reinforced stitching. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but can retain moisture if you sweat a lot. - **Modal/Bamboo**: Soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Microfiber/Performance Blends**: Excellent moisture management, quick‑dry, less odor. - **Spandex/Lycra**: Adds stretch and shape retention. 4. **Durability & Care** - Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and leg seams. - Check washing instructions; many performance fabrics require cold wash and no dryer. 5. **Style & Personal Preference** - If you like a minimalist look, go for plain colors and simple cuts. - For a pop of personality, choose printed or patterned boxers/trunks. --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Known For | Best Style | |-------|-----------|------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs, iconic logo | Classic briefs | | **Hanes** | Affordable, durable | Boxer briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Innovative fabrics (AIRism) | Performance boxer briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric, seamless | Boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Pouch support, ergonomic | Compression briefs | | **Patagonia** | Eco‑friendly, durable | Eco‑friendly boxers | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | Compression briefs | | **Lululemon** | Premium fabrics | Performance boxer briefs | --- ## Quick Tips for Buying - **Try Before You Buy**: If possible, test a few styles in-store or order from brands with generous return policies. - **Check the Size Chart**: Sizes can vary between brands; always refer to the specific brand’s chart. - **Read Reviews**: Look for comments on fit, durability, and how the underwear holds up after multiple washes. - **Consider a Mix**: Many men keep a rotation of different styles—boxer briefs for daily wear, briefs for work, and boxers for sleep. --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort and versatility**: Boxer briefs are the safest bet. - **For maximum support during workouts**: Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. - **For a relaxed, breathable feel**: Boxers or loose briefs. - **For eco‑friendly options**: Look for organic cotton or bamboo blends. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, and you’ll be comfortable all day, every day. Happy shopping!
